review.material: Publisher-deposited DOI metadata for the two-page SIGGRAPH Art Gallery contribution was inspected. The exact contribution’s abstract and full text were not accessible.
review.limitations: A similarly titled four-author SIGraDi paper concerns related work but is a different publication; its results are not attributed automatically to this six-author record.

sections.title: What is verified
sections.text: This is a short contribution to the ACM SIGGRAPH 2008 Art Gallery, credited to Knight, Sass, Griffith, Kamath, Preston and Goldenberg. Its two-page format should be distinguished from longer research reports about visual–physical grammars.

sections.title: What cannot yet be summarized
sections.text: The exact text was not accessible in this review. Its premise, methods, demonstrated artifact and conclusions therefore remain unverified; no detailed abstract has been invented from its title.

sections.title: How to follow it
sections.text: Use the original record for this exhibition contribution. When reading related visual–physical grammar work, compare title, authors, venue and year before treating two texts as the same study.
